_readme: 积分 (v11.0.0, tech plan S20, the owner 2026-10-29). packs: 10元 = 1000 积分, 5% more for each 10元 from 20元 up, +25% at 50元. Every AI request is paid at its measured token cost (src/points): pricing keeps a gross margin of at least `margin` on the cheapest 积分 (the largest pack's), after the payment fee and VAT, at a cautious usd_cny; a model without a list price is priced as reference_model. estimates are the tokens a request sends and writes (all its steps, the paused guard left out): they price it before it runs, set what is held (hold_factor times that), and are what it is charged when no tokens are reported (the mock). Inputs measured 2026-10-29 from the prompts the pipelines build (1.3 tokens per CJK character, 3.5 other characters per token); outputs include Claude's thinking. per_topic and per_card add to a reading for each topic asked (八字) or card drawn (塔罗). inquiry: the 深度分析's flat fee covers typical_turns turns and one largest_turn. dev_grant: what each dev account starts with, given once.
